news.title: DHS Proposes New OPT Fee as International Students Face New Restrictions
news.summary_en: Colleges and universities would have to pay $70,000 for each international student they recommend for Optional Practical Training (OPT) under a Trump administration proposal announced Oct. 7.

news.title: Last Chance to Take Advantage of ACEx2027 Early Bird Rates
news.summary_en: Register now to gain the Early Bird discount rate for the ACE Experience 2027 (ACEx2027) before it ends at midnight, Oct. 14.
